page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.8xlarge is a GPU-accelerated instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance integrates two NVIDIA P4 GPUs, providing a total of 16 GB of VRAM to accelerate parallel computing tasks.

This server configuration does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system deployment and data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps, which manages data transfers between the instance, attached storage, and external networks.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile balances dedicated x86_64 compute resources with entry-level enterprise GPUs. This makes it a viable option for workloads that require GPU acceleration without the high cost overhead of top-tier accelerators. Suitable workloads include video transcoding, low-latency inference, entry-level deep learning, and parallelized data processing tasks.
